Title: +1 Objective Control
Description: Adds 1 Objective Control to the Unit.

Title: +1 Attack (M)
Description: Adds 1 Attack to each Melee Weapon on the Unit.

Title: +1 Strength (M)
Description: Adds 1 Strength to each Melee Weapon on the Unit.

Title: +1 AP (M)
Description: Improves the AP of each Melee Weapon on the Unit by 1. Example: AP -1 becomes AP -2.

Title: +1 Damage (M)
Description: Adds 1 Damage to each Melee Weapon on the Unit.

Title: +5 Pts
Description: Changes the cost for each model in the unit.

Title: +10 Pts
Description: Changes the cost for each model in the unit.

Title: +20 Pts
Description: Changes the cost for each model in the unit.
